SELECT DISTINCT p.*, pc.code AS categoryCode, pc.name AS categoryName
FROM policy p JOIN policy_target_region ptr ON p.id = ptr.policy_id LEFT JOIN policy_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id
WHERE ptr.sgg_code = #{region} AND ( (p.min_age = 0 AND p.max_age = 0) OR ( p.min_age <= #{age} AND p.max_age >= #{age} ) )
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.apply_method LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.required_documents LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND pc.code = #{categoryCode}
ORDER BY p.category_similarity DESC, p.category_similarity IS NULL, p.id DESC

SELECT id, code, name, description, embedding
FROM policy_category
WHERE embedding IS NULL
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, code, name, description, embedding
FROM policy_category
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, title, description, embedding
FROM policy
WHERE embedding IS NULL
ORDER BY id
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, title, description, embedding, category_id, category_similarity
FROM policy
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
AND ( category_id IS NULL OR category_similarity IS NULL )
ORDER BY id
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM policy
WHERE embedding IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM policy
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
AND ( category_id IS NULL OR category_similarity IS NULL )

SELECT DISTINCT p.*, pc.code AS categoryCode, pc.name AS categoryName
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_target_region ptr ON p.id = ptr.policy_id
JOIN policy_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id
WHERE ptr.sgg_code = #{region}
AND ( (p.min_age = 0 AND p.max_age = 0) OR ( p.min_age <= #{age} AND p.max_age >= #{age} ) )
AND pc.code = 'HOUSING'
AND p.category_similarity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.category_similarity DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT 3
